lines.t: [Intro - spoken softly, like prayer over beat]
‎Let's go...
‎[Verse 1]
‎Came in cryin', first breath hit the air,
‎This deranged world, wicked from the jump, despair everywhere.
‎Raised in the chaos, minds twisted from the start,
‎But YahuShua called, pierced right through the heart.
‎Brain broke at twenty, thought it was just spiritual war,
‎Rapid-fire noise, couldn't slow down no more.
‎Now meds slow the spin, blunt the impulse rush,
‎Special gift in the silence, feel The Spirit's hush.
‎Testin' every thought, like gold in the fire refined,
‎Askin' for remodel—neuro-plastic divine.
‎Not my strength, but His grace rewirin' the lines,
‎Obedience steppin', leavin' old ways behind.
‎Oh, renew my mind... YahuShua, transform this weary frame... (ooh, transform me)
‎Don't conform to this world, no... in Your holy name I claim... (I claim it, Lord)
‎Be transformed by the renewing, day by day, oh day by day... (renew me slow)
‎Hear Your Spirit speak so soft, show me the narrow way... (guide my steps)
‎For all those who have ears to hear, let the truth ring true and clear... (let it ring, oh let it ring)
‎In this wicked generation, YahuShua, You're my King... forever King! (You're my everything)
‎Fasting from the flesh forever, with You I stay, I stay... (never let me go)
‎Spirit search my heart deep, lead me all the way... all the way home. (ooh, search me, Lord)
‎[Verse 2]
‎Accidental fasts, days on cigs alone,
‎Body cryin' out, but spirit comin' home.
‎Want that fast eternal, from flesh forever free,
‎Crucify the old man, let Your life live in me.
‎Not exempted, nah, I got ears to hear the call,
‎God my Judge, Spirit searchin' one and all.
‎We all suffered heavy, born into the storm,
‎But in the fire, Your love keeps us warm.
‎From the Volumes, obedience more than trust alone,
‎Bears good fruit when heart's fully known.
‎"Obedience is more than trust, and trust much more than obedience..."
‎Says The Lord.
‎Romans twelve verse two, straight from the page:
‎"And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God."
‎No more brain noise chains, no more impulse chains,
‎In YahuShua's peace, calmness remains.
‎[Verse 3]
‎This most wicked generation, full measure fillin' up,
‎But we cry out for mercy, liftin' the cup.
‎Hearin' His voice clearer in the slowed-down space,
‎Flesh fastin' daily, runnin' this race.
‎Neuro-plastic power, by His Spirit's might,
‎Day by day renewin', steppin' into light.
‎For all who got ears, let the truth resound,
‎In YahuShua we rise, no longer bound.
‎Fasting from flesh, forever with The Lord...
‎Renewed mind, calm in YahuShua...
‎He got you, brother... peace...
‎YahuShua is King.
